detail.lead: One-way vision perforated film turns glass into advertising space without closing it off: passers-by see the printed graphic, while people inside keep their view and daylight. Two standard perforation ratios are available: 70/30 keeps more printable surface, so the graphic reads fuller; 60/40 opens more of the film, giving a clearer view out and more daylight inside. Choose the ratio for the glazing and the viewing distance; roll width and pricing are confirmed per order.
